name: visual-design-studio
description: Design anything: a design director, a Design Space Atlas of styles, industries, markets, audiences, archetypes, price tiers and channels, discipline skills with concrete defaults, DTCG tokens and a render-and-critique loop, plus independent brand-project continuity.

interface.longDescription: A design director that turns a brief into scored, rendered directions; a 125-entry Design Space Atlas; 14 discipline skills with concrete defaults; DTCG tokens with contrast linting; a React reference system; and a render-and-critique quality loop. Supervised evaluation; client and device acceptance remain project-specific.
defaultPrompt: Find the best design direction for this brief.
